summary: The reduction to the accepted normalized parity-midpoint theorem has the correct scaling and proves the carrier, mass, barycenter, and closed-halfspace assertions. The target-fiber identity follows exactly by conditioning on the discrete base midpoint. Convexity and Brunn-Minkowski give the pointwise reflected-fiber bound, and the subsequent Cauchy-Schwarz argument correctly yields the paritywise estimate, including zero-volume and lower-dimensional fibers. No mathematical error or gap was found.
